description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawala, Rathmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. The content focuses on land ownership registration, property boundaries, and title settlement - all falling under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
